name: mobile-responsive-simulator
description: Chrome, Edge & Firefox extension for simulating 81+ responsive devices with side-by-side comparison, touch emulation, transparent mockups and video demos.

scripts.validate: node -c background/service_worker.js popup/popup.js simulator/js/*.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json')); JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('rules/dnr-rules.json')); console.log('✓ All files valid!')"
scripts.build:zip: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/mobile-simulator-v1.0.0.zip && zip -r dist/mobile-simulator-v1.0.0.zip manifest.json rules background popup simulator icons -x '*.DS_Store' && echo '✓ Chrome Web Store Package created at dist/mobile-simulator-v1.0.0.zip'

author: Shakil Sarker
